# Git Workflow

## Commits

- One logical change per commit; imperative subject ("Add X", not "Added").
- Subject ≤ 50 chars; body explains WHY, not what the diff already shows.
- Never commit secrets, generated files, or unrelated churn.

## Branches

- Short-lived feature branches off an up-to-date main.
- Rebase to keep a linear history; merge for shared long-lived branches.

## Safety

- Before `reset --hard` / `push --force`, check there's no safer option.
- `git reflog` recovers almost anything — don't panic.
- Force-push only your own branches, never shared ones.
